versions.changelog:
Initial release of porteden-email.

- Secure multi-account email management for Gmail, Outlook, and Exchange via Porteden CLI
- Added scripts for email read/search/send, attachment handling, and profile switching
- Credentials securely stored in system keyring; no plaintext risk
- English skill doc replaced with detailed Chinese guide and usage examples
- Added package.json and PowerShell script; removed deprecated skill-card.md
